title: Bloom — Automated Behavioural Safety Evaluation, One Generation Later
blurb: Eleven risky behaviours, two open-weight target models two years apart, one AI judge. What an automated behavioural audit finds, and what it cannot.
description: A research report using Anthropic's open-source Bloom framework to probe eleven risky behaviours (emotional bonding, social-engineering assistance, self-preservation, sycophancy and more) in Llama 3.3 70B (2024) and Meta Muse Glimmer 30B (2026), with a re-judged baseline and a judge-drift check.
data_provenance: bloom-session/bloom-results (March 2026) and bloom-session/runs-2026-10 (October 2026), exported by export_data.py
